Online booking has become the norm for everything from haircuts to grocery deliveries. This means people are more likely to look online when scheduling all kinds of activities and services, including massage therapy. [To attract clients online](https://pro.massagebook.com/blog/massage-therapy-marketing), every massage therapist needs a visually appealing, informative website for their practice.

Thankfully, building a simple business website is far less complicated than it used to be. Instead of coding an entire site from scratch, massage therapists can leverage a website builder.

# 25 Inspiring Examples of Massage Therapist Websites

Last Updated January 7 2026

![](/assets/images/steve-benjamins-avatar.jpg)

Written By [Steve Benjamins](https://www.sitebuilderreport.com/steve-benjamins)

A good massage therapist website should have relaxing color tones and a clear outline of services. If you’re using a tool like [Squarespace Scheduling](https://www.sitebuilderreport.com/try/squarespace) you can even let clients book appointments on your website.

Massage therapy is of course an _intimate_ experience. Because of that, trust is really important. A good way to build trust is to show who you are on your website— make sure to show pictures of yourself and to use friendly language.

_Tip:_ Use ← and → arrow keys to browse.

## [1\. Saltwater Massage Studio](https://www.saltwatermassage.com/)

[Made With Squarespace](https://squarespace.syuh.net/XxdWBg)

[![Screenshot of Saltwater Massage Studio, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/caf4416c-10d1-4976-99db-e79ba2459e43/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](https://www.saltwatermassage.com/)  

Gretchen Lee is the founder of this boutique style massage studio in Massachusetts. They host many therapists that provide a more modern massage service such as cupping, CBD based sessions and more.

  

## [2\. Height of Health Massage](http://heightofhealthmassage.com/)

[Made With Squarespace](https://squarespace.syuh.net/XxdWBg)

[![Screenshot of Height of Health Massage, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/0fa9c0fe-ab19-4dc6-8b95-f8641d0d1d84/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](http://heightofhealthmassage.com/)  

This massage clinic is made up of four different massage therapists and is located in Colorado. They aim to provide relaxing and restorative treatments at an affordable rate for their clients. Their menu includes services like deep tissue massage and prenatal massages.

  

## [3\. Holden Beach Massage](https://www.holdenbeachmassage.net/)

[Made With Wix](https://wix.pxf.io/c/41544/2097939/25616)

[![Screenshot of Holden Beach Massage, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/20c37cea-90b7-4e00-b44c-7e3b83308c06/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](https://www.holdenbeachmassage.net/)  

David Morris is a massage therapist working out of North Carolina specializing in a vacation vibe for his clients. Besides relaxation, his services increase circulation, range of motion and mental clarity.

  

## [4\. Omega Massage and Wellness](https://www.omegamassage.ca/)

[Made With Squarespace](https://squarespace.syuh.net/XxdWBg)

[![Screenshot of Omega Massage and Wellness, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/ce55e2ac-370a-4ec3-8a8e-90b7d49283a3/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](https://www.omegamassage.ca/)  

Mellisha Fehr created Omega Massage and Wellness which has been called “the best massage in Calgary.” The practice is based on finding overall vitality using a holistic approach. The menu includes a Reset Cleanse, Therapeutic Massage and Energy Healing Massage.

  

## [5\. Bodyworks Bliss](https://www.bodyworksbliss.net/)

[Made With Wordpress](https://www.wqwln8trk.com/2CW6XNM57/TZ3X1FRR/)

[![Screenshot of Bodyworks Bliss, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/f53876b7-83b0-49d2-879c-a93f3463e729/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](https://www.bodyworksbliss.net/)  

This massage therapy clinic is located in the beautiful state of Utah, in the perfect setting to relax. Clients can unwind with standard massage services or receive more specific care for painful areas.

  

## [6\. Lauta Health](https://lautahealth.co.uk/)

[Made With Carrd](https://try.carrd.co/r2x1byk2)

[![Screenshot of Lauta Health, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/93750d2d-a3b3-4b6d-938f-b37cac519b7e/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](https://lautahealth.co.uk/)  

Sarah is the massage therapist behind Lauta Health. While working in a different field, she discovered her ability to heal stress and pain using massage therapy. She now offers sports massage, deep tissue massage and prenatal care.

  

## [7\. Float Luxury Spa](https://www.floatluxuryspa.com/)

[Made With Squarespace](https://squarespace.syuh.net/XxdWBg)

[![Screenshot of Float Luxury Spa, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/8c3b0d45-85fc-40fc-83f8-39fe445d01d0/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](https://www.floatluxuryspa.com/)  

Float Luxury Spa is located in California and offers high-end massage services. With top notch care from start to finish, they aim to make their guests so relaxed, that they feel like they are floating on air.

  

## [8\. Rub Massage Austin](https://www.rubmassageaustin.com/)

[Made With Squarespace](https://squarespace.syuh.net/XxdWBg)

[![Screenshot of Rub Massage Austin, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/77847323-61b6-4132-800a-96f1907bf81c/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](https://www.rubmassageaustin.com/)  

Glen Taylor is the man and massage therapist behind Rub Massage Austin. He has been servicing clients for over ten years and takes a simple approach to care that has earned him hundreds of positive reviews.

  

## [9\. Zenergy Massage and Wellness](https://www.zenergytahoe.com/)

[Made With Squarespace](https://squarespace.syuh.net/XxdWBg)

[![Screenshot of Zenergy Massage and Wellness, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/52a7cdc9-f75b-477a-8994-0e1aa7382ec7/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](https://www.zenergytahoe.com/)  

Amber Defazio and James Hainsworth are the founders of Zenergy Massage and Wellness in California. Alongside several other massage therapists, they provide services that include relaxing treatments as well as restorative ones for sports therapy. They also offer wellness packages that include multiple treatments.

  

## [10\. Lavandula](http://lavandulawellnesscentre.com/)

[Made With Weebly](https://square.sjv.io/c/41544/1231833/9398)

[![Screenshot of Lavandula, from the massage therapist websites collection.](https://ucarecdn.com/e3841a5d-0327-41f6-8896-6b7574e16994/-/resize/1200x/-/format/auto/-/quality/smart/)](http://lavandulawellnesscentre.com/)  

Stephanie Muir is a registered Massage Therapist currently represented by Lavandula Spa. She is skilled in acupuncture, Indian head massage and cosmetic facial acupuncture.
